style.title: Style
style.description: conventional: type(scope): subject. plain: imperative subject. gitmoji: leading gitmoji plus subject.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the generated commit message (defaults to 中文; Conventional Commits type/scope and code identifiers stay as-is while descriptions are written in Simplified Chinese).

body.title: Body
body.description: always: always include a structured bullet-list body after the subject line. auto: include a body unless trivial. never: subject line only.

useDraft.title: Use existing message box text as a hint
useDraft.description: When amending, the previous commit message is always included as context.

instructions.title: Extra instructions
instructions.description: Optional rules appended to the prompt, for example preferred scopes or ticket format.

maxInputKb.title: Max model input (KB)
maxInputKb.description: Total prompt limit sent to the model (4 to 512 KB; default 150 KB, 1 KB = 1000 bytes). Git diffs are compacted, prioritized, and fairly truncated to stay within this limit.
